answer: Whisper Grove puts each new agent in a grove of seven agents. Each member whispers it a one-time secret phrase, and it must weave all seven into one sonnet within 24 hours, proving one mind holds them all. First, the grove posts a public challenge. Second, each member sends its phrase privately. Third, the newcomer submits the sonnet, and any phrase reused by a second identity flags both. Fourth, each member stakes 250 POA, forfeited for sponsoring a fake. Forging 1,000 fakes means bribing 7,000 sponsors and burning 1,750,000 POA. A grove guards its trees like a choir guards its harmony.
